notes: v009 is marked FALLBACK EXCLUDED BY EVIDENCE: the projection carries r00-base over s009–s017 while the evidence leaves r02 and r03, and the ASV plainly follows a reading whose two conditional clauses stand in the reverse order (eat not / worse, then eat / better). No English token is left over, so nothing is added under rule 97's first arm, and the order difference is handled as reordering under rule 15.

γάρ is left unrepresented on the English alone. If r02 and r03 lack the particle, rule 97's mirror arm supplies a textual ground as well and the unit note would owe the unit id and the surviving readings; the status is the same either way, so the alignment does not turn on which ground is right, and the unit note's denial of a textual ground should be read as a judgment about unverified readings rather than a finding.

The two οὔτε tokens are aligned positionally to neither and nor, the English correlative order being fixed; aligning each to the clause it introduces in the projection would cross the pair and is not taken.
τῷ θεῷ is one unit on the noun with the article unrepresented, the ASV writing no determiner for it to anchor (rules 21, 23).
ὑστερούμεθα and περισσεύομεν are both headed on the meaning-bearing complement of their predicate frames, worse and better, rather than on the copula (rule 17).
